youtube.baslik: Why is a nine-month-old tested like a seven-month-old? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In babies born preterm, development is judged by corrected age: an example baby aged nine months and born eight weeks early has a corrected age of about seven months, and test choice follows that. Without correction, responses may wrongly seem delayed for age; corrected age is usually considered until about age two.
